reproduction: Copy the current source/apixis package into a temporary source overlay.
Replace only core/event/base.py and core/event/event_loop.py using the archived HEAD files identified by baseline_file_sha256.
Set PYTHONPATH to the temporary source overlay and verify both event modules import from it.
Run python -m pytest -q with selected_test, -k "not body", --tb=short and a 30 second external subprocess watchdog.

overview_chart.interpretation: Each point compares against its own matched ABBA baseline. Negative is faster. Lines connect adjacent measurements only; missing scenarios are not interpolated. This is not a cumulative version-performance index.
